product_name: vivo V70 Elite 5G (Sand Beige, 12GB RAM, 256GB Storage) with No Cost EMI/Additional Exchange Offers
description: [ZEISS Professional Imaging]: Experience elite photography with a triple-camera system: a 50MP ZEISS OIS Main Camera (Sony IMX766), a 50MP ZEISS Night Telephoto Camera (Sony IMX882), and an 8MP Ultra Wide-Angle lens, all engineered to meet rigorous ZEISS optical standards. FRONT: 50 MP ZEISS group selfie camera: AF, f/2.0, FOV 92°, 5P lens. [ZEISS Night Telephoto Mastery]: Capture the night with class-leading clarity using the 50MP Telephoto lens featuring 3X optical zoom and up to 100X digital zoom, ensuring distant subjects are rendered with stunning detail even in low light. [Flagship Snapdragon 8s Gen 3]: Powered by a 4nm flagship processor that delivers an incredible speed, optimized for elite performance, smooth 90fps gaming, and advanced AI multitasking. [16.74 cm (6.59 inches) 1.5K Ultra-Narrow Bezel Display]: Enjoy immersive visuals on a 120Hz 1.5K OLED display with side bezels reduced to just 0.125 cm and a local peak brightness of 5000 nits for perfect outdoor visibility. [Massive 6500mAh BlueVolt Battery]: Stay powered for up to two days with a high-capacity 6500mAh battery designed to handle heavy professional use while maintaining an ultra-slim and lightweight profile. [90W FlashCharge Technology]: Rapidly recharge your device with 90W FlashCharge support, ensuring you spend more time on the go and less time waiting at a power outlet. [Premium Metal Frame Design]: A masterpiece of engineering featuring a compact metal frame and a "Flagship Metallic Camera Module," providing a sophisticated, high-end hand-feel and superior structural strength.
